selection_rule: Select the first 60 eligible chronological Mirage demos after 2026-09-12.

historical_data_boundary.v2_13_reserves: Gate 0-2 design evidence only; FORBIDDEN for V3 model fitting.

development_role: D_V3_DEV may be used for baseline fitting, feature development, model selection, hyperparameter selection, calibration, and grouped development evaluation.
confirmation_boundary: D_V3_CONFIRM must be collected later from a strictly newer chronological period and must remain untouched until V3 is frozen.
rationale: V3 is a 15-class forecasting task. A 60-match development corpus provides substantially more match-level diversity than the earlier 20-match V0 development corpus and supports approximately 12 held-out matches per fold in 5-fold grouped CV. This is a development-scale design choice, not a statistical power guarantee.
